hero.title: Your junta, without the notebook or the screenshots
hero.problem: Keeping count of who paid, chasing receipts and reminding late members still happens in notebooks and group chats.
hero.solution: Pozzo checks each payment receipt, shows the pot in real time and reminds whoever is late, so the organizer stops keeping the books by hand.
hero.nomoney.title: Pozzo never holds or moves your money
hero.nomoney.text: Members keep paying each other directly with Yape or Plin. Pozzo only keeps the record.
hero.alt.validated: Pozzo screen confirming a validated payment with the period, amount, date and operation number.
how.title: How it works
how.step1.title: Create or join a junta
how.step1.text: The organizer sets the amount, the number of members, the schedule and the turn order. Everyone else joins with a code.
how.step2.title: Pay and upload the receipt
how.step2.text: Each member transfers straight to whoever collects this round, then uploads the receipt from their phone.
how.step3.title: Pozzo checks and keeps count
how.step3.text: Pozzo reads the receipt, compares it with what was expected, updates the pot and reminds anyone who is late.
trust.title: Your money never touches Pozzo
trust.point1: No wallets to connect or funds to deposit.
trust.point3: No cut of the pot: Kerolabs never takes a percentage of what your group saves.
features.title: Everything the organizer used to do by hand
features.caption: App screens are shown in Spanish.
features.receipts.title: Receipts checked for you
features.receipts.text: Upload the receipt and Pozzo reads the amount, date, recipient and operation number. If something does not match, the organizer reviews it with the proof in front of them.
features.receipts.alt: Pozzo screen showing the data read from a receipt and a green message saying it matches what was expected.
features.pot.title: The pot, in real time
features.pot.text: See who has paid, who is under review and who is pending, and how much is missing before the cutoff date.
features.pot.alt: Pozzo screen with the pot of period 3, a progress bar and the payment status of each of the eight members.
features.reminders.title: Automatic reminders
features.reminders.text: Pozzo reminds whoever has not paid before the cutoff date, so nobody has to play debt collector in the group chat.
features.reminders.alt: Pozzo notices screen with automatic reminders turned on and a list of recent events.
features.turns.title: Fair turns: draw, agreed order or auction
features.turns.text: Choose how the collection order is set. The draw and the agreed order come in the first version; the auction follows later.
features.turns.alt: Pozzo screen to choose the turn method: draw, agreed order or auction.
features.history.title: A track record that travels with you
features.history.text: Each member builds a compliance history from validated payments and can share it when joining a new group, instead of relying on word of mouth.
features.history.alt: Pozzo screen with a 93 percent on-time rate and a list of the member's groups.
team.title: The team behind Pozzo
team.mission.label: Our mission
team.mission.text: To make savings groups easier to run with a simple and reliable digital tool that organizes contributions, turns and receipts, cutting manual work and improving transparency among members.
team.about: Kerolabs is a Peruvian community fintech startup. We are Software Engineering students at Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas (UPC).

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.s1.title: About this site
terms.s1.text: This website presents Pozzo, a student project developed by Kerolabs at Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas (UPC). It is informational: it describes the app and lets you join a waitlist. The app is not published yet.
terms.s2.title: What this site offers
terms.s2.text: You can read about Pozzo and leave your name and an email or mobile number to receive one notice when the app is available. Nothing else is sold or offered here.
terms.s3.title: Pozzo does not handle money
terms.s3.text: Pozzo is designed to keep the record of a savings group: contributions, receipts and turns. It does not hold, receive, transfer or guarantee funds. Members pay each other directly. Kerolabs does not take a percentage of what a group saves.
terms.s4.title: No warranty
terms.s4.text: The site is provided as is, as part of a student project. We do not guarantee that it will always be available or free of errors, or that the app will be released on a given date.
terms.s5.title: Intellectual property
terms.s5.text: The Pozzo name, logo, texts, designs and app screens belong to Kerolabs, except where another owner is stated. For example, the Plus Jakarta Sans font is used under the SIL Open Font License. You may not copy or reuse our material without written permission.
terms.s6.title: Changes
terms.s6.text: We may update these terms. The date at the top shows the latest version. If you keep using the site after a change, you accept the new version.
terms.s7.title: Applicable law
terms.s7.text: These terms are governed by the laws of Peru. Any dispute is subject to the competent courts of Peru.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1.title: Who is responsible
privacy.s1.text: Kerolabs, a student startup from Peru, is the data controller for the information collected on this site. Contact: {email}.
privacy.s2.title: What we collect
privacy.s2.text: Only what you type in the waitlist form: your name, an email address or mobile number, and your acceptance of these terms. Sharing it is voluntary. We do not ask for money, ID numbers or payment details.
privacy.s3.title: How we use it
privacy.s3.text: To send you one notice when the Pozzo app is available, and to answer you if you write to us. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
privacy.s4.title: Who processes it
privacy.s4.text: The form data is received by the form provider configured for this site. If no provider is configured, the form opens your email app and the message travels through your own email service to Kerolabs.
privacy.s5.title: Cookies and local storage
privacy.s5.text: This site sets no cookies and has no analytics or tracking. The theme button saves your choice (system, light or dark) in your browser's local storage. That value stays on your device and is not sent to us or to anyone else.
privacy.s6.title: How long we keep it
privacy.s6.text: Until we send the launch notice or until you ask us to delete your data, whichever comes first.
privacy.s7.title: Your rights
privacy.s7.text: Under Peru's Ley N.º 29733 (Ley de Protección de Datos Personales) you can ask to access, correct or delete your data. Write to {email} and tell us which right you want to use.
privacy.s8.title: Changes
privacy.s8.text: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the latest version.
